about: The collecta of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass at Dawn” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that since we are flooded with the new light of Thy Word made flesh, that which shineth through faith in our mind may also shine forth in our deeds. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.

seg.nr: Then commemoration is made of Saint Anastasia, Martyr.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who keep the solemn feast of blessed Anastasia, Thy Martyr, may feel her patronage before Thee. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
